definition: Cube 3D is an artificial intelligence model that is developed by Roblox Corporation.
details: It is open source and available on GitHub and Hugging Face. In March 2026, Roblox announced Cube 3D as a mesh generation model that takes text input. In February 2026, Roblox released 4D creation in a public beta, allowing embedding Cube 3D into Roblox games. Cube 3D is integrated into Roblox Studio and its API, and supports two modes of 4D creation.

explainer.lead: Cube 3D is Roblox Corporation's open-source model for turning text into 3D meshes. It brings generated objects into Roblox's creation tools and supports 4D creation inside games.

tiers.eli5: You describe an object in words, and it builds the 3D shape for you, like asking for a model of a chair and getting one you can put in a game.
tiers.practitioner: Developers embed Cube 3D into Roblox games via Roblox Studio and its API, using text prompts for mesh generation. A pitfall is assuming generated meshes need no review before shipping in a game.
tiers.paperLevel: A text-to-mesh generation model announced by Roblox in March 2026, open source on GitHub and Hugging Face, with two modes of 4D creation. Its documented scope is mesh generation from text, not full scene synthesis.

components.name: Text input
components.detail: A written description supplies the request for a generated object.

components.name: Mesh generation model
components.detail: Cube 3D converts the text input into a 3D mesh.

components.name: Roblox integration
components.detail: Roblox Studio and its API make the model available within creation workflows, including two modes of 4D creation.

flow: A creator provides text describing the desired object.
Cube 3D processes the text and generates a 3D mesh.
The result can be used through Roblox Studio and its API.
Embedding Cube 3D in a Roblox game enables its supported 4D creation modes.
explainer.origin: Roblox Corporation developed Cube 3D and announced it in March 2026. The model is open source and available on GitHub and Hugging Face.
explainer.lineage: In February 2026, Roblox released 4D creation in public beta, allowing Cube 3D to be embedded in Roblox games.
explainer.whyItMatters: Cube 3D connects text-based mesh generation directly to Roblox's creation tools and games. Its open-source availability also lets people obtain the model outside those integrations.
